subject.title: feat: bound raw transcript reads across replacements

question: Should OpenClaw add a durable v13 transcript-generation migration and expose generation-aware raw transcript cursors as a supported Plugin SDK API?
rationale: This is an intentional persistent-state and external API expansion, not a mechanical defect: the repository policy requires explicit approval for schema-version bumps, and the cursor result shape would become a long-lived plugin contract.

options.title: Approve the bounded cursor foundation
options.body: Accept the v13 migration and public cursor API, then require focused upgrade and Plugin SDK compatibility review before merge.

options.title: Keep the optimization internal
options.body: Retain only an owner-local bounded active-memory read path and remove the new public cursor surface and schema migration unless a concrete supported plugin consumer requires them.

options.title: Defer the API decision
options.body: Pause this PR until a maintainer defines the durable transcript pagination and external-plugin support direction.

recommendation.title: Approve the bounded cursor foundation
recommendation.body: Accept the v13 migration and public cursor API, then require focused upgrade and Plugin SDK compatibility review before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The branch author owns the technical proposal and stacked follow-up design, though final product acceptance must come from a repository maintainer.
